title: Auto Replant Crop
description: Automatically replants crops after harvesting. Works in survival and multiplayer.
body:
This datapack automatically replants crops when harvested.

Supported crops:
• Wheat
• Carrots
• Potatoes
• Beetroot

Works in survival and multiplayer worlds.

Installation:
1. Download the datapack
2. Put it in the world's datapacks folder
3. Run /reload
